name: ground-control
description: Assigned GitHub issues and local Claude Code and Codex sessions.

groundControl.github.logins.markdownDescription: Comma-separated GitHub usernames whose assigned issues appear on the board.

enumDescriptions: Assigned issues on the configured project.
All open assigned issues in the repository.

groundControl.github.projectNumber.markdownDescription: Project number used when Card Source is Project.

groundControl.github.projectOwner.markdownDescription: Organization or user that owns the project. Empty uses the repository owner.

groundControl.github.statusField.markdownDescription: Single-select project field read as card status. Only the built-in `Status` field records changes on the issue timeline, which triage reads; other fields supply the current value only.

groundControl.github.maxPages.markdownDescription: Pages of up to 100 assigned issues read per refresh. Each page is one GitHub API request; the board reports when more issues match than were read.

groundControl.boardStatuses.markdownDescription: Project statuses that keep cards active; other statuses archive them.

groundControl.statusLanes.markdownDescription: Map project statuses to initial lanes using the [placement rules](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#board-settings).

enumDescriptions: The selected pull request's author, so a review card names who implemented the issue.
The assignee, preferring your configured identity.
groundControl.avatar.review.markdownDescription: Whose avatar a card shows while its status maps to the Review lane, in both clients.

enumDescriptions: The assignee, preferring your configured identity.
The issue author, so a card names who reported the issue.
groundControl.avatar.offReview.markdownDescription: Whose avatar a card shows on every other status, in both clients.

groundControl.animations.markdownDescription: Animate working borders, running session names, and tooltips on the editor board. The system reduced-motion preference disables them regardless.

groundControl.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds between issue refreshes while a board is visible.

groundControl.agents.markdownDescription: Map agent IDs to CLI commands or paths, replacing the [default agent selection](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#session-settings).

groundControl.sessionRefreshSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds between session refreshes while a board is visible.

groundControl.branchIssuePattern.markdownDescription: Regular expression whose first capture group extracts the issue number from a branch or directory name.

groundControl.newSession.prompt.markdownDescription: Unsent prompt for new Claude sessions, with [card placeholders](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#session-settings).

groundControl.installSessionHooks.markdownDescription: Allow selected session hooks; turning this off removes Ground Control hooks for every agent.

groundControl.sessionHooks.claude.markdownDescription: Install Claude activity hooks when Claude and Install Session Hooks are enabled.

groundControl.sessionHooks.codex.markdownDescription: Install Codex activity hooks when Codex and Install Session Hooks are enabled; disabling reduces live session discovery.

groundControl.openWindowsForSessions.markdownDescription: Allow opening sessions to focus another VS Code window or open a new one.

groundControl.sessions.includeRepositori.markdownDescription: Repositories to show, combined with directory includes using the [session scope rules](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#session-scope).

groundControl.sessions.excludeRepositori.markdownDescription: Repositories to hide; exclusions override includes and also hide sessions whose repository is unknown.

groundControl.sessions.includeDirectorie.markdownDescription: Absolute directories and descendants to show, combined with repository includes.

groundControl.sessions.excludeDirectorie.markdownDescription: Absolute directories and descendants to hide, overriding includes.

groundControl.sessions.showHistory.markdownDescription: Show saved session rows; hiding them does not stop underlying safety reads.

groundControl.sessions.showAdHoc.markdownDescription: Show session cards without a confirmed issue; hiding them does not stop discovery.

groundControl.resumeWorktreesInRepositor.markdownDescription: Resume Claude worktree sessions in the repository's window; applies to worktrees under `.claude/worktrees`.

groundControl.triage.enabled.markdownDescription: Legacy triage switch overridden by an explicit triage.mode.
groundControl.triage.enabled.deprecationMessage: Use groundControl.triage.mode. Explicit legacy true selects automatic; false selects off when no explicit mode exists.

groundControl.triage.mode.markdownDescription: Choose whether to classify cards off-machine using your model allowance, following the [mode and compatibility rules](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#triage-settings).

groundControl.triage.dailyLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum automatic attempts per rolling 24 hours, including failures and cancellations (zero pauses automatic starts; manual requests are independent).

groundControl.triage.model.markdownDescription: Full Claude model name used to classify cards.

groundControl.triage.names.markdownDescription: Map GitHub usernames to display names, overriding their profiles.

groundControl.triage.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Maximum seconds to fetch and classify one card.

groundControl.actions.merge-upstream.ena.markdownDescription: Automatically run the configured merge prompt when triage identifies a request to merge upstream.

groundControl.actions.merge-upstream.pro.markdownDescription: Prompt for merge sessions that may push changes, following the [prompt and result format](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#action-settings).

groundControl.actions.agent.markdownDescription: Agent for card actions; auto selects the first enabled dispatcher, Claude before Codex.

groundControl.actions.model.markdownDescription: Model for card actions; empty uses the selected CLI default independently of triage.

groundControl.actions.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Permissions for action sessions, subject to [agent support](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#action-settings).
enumDescriptions: Approve file edits; ask before other restricted operations (Claude only).

groundControl.actions.dailyLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum action starts per rolling 24 hours; zero allows only manual starts.

groundControl.actions.resultMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes to wait for a dispatched session to appear before marking it lost.

groundControl.github.ghPath.markdownDescription: GitHub CLI command or executable path.

groundControl.hosts.markdownDescription: Editor IDs to connect to; currently supports `vscode`.

groundControl.sources.markdownDescription: Work source IDs to read; currently supports `github`.

groundControl.stateDirectory.markdownDescription: Absolute directory for Ground Control state and logs; empty keeps `~/.claude/ground-control`. Changing it moves the existing state, following the [relocation rules](https://github.com/jon-or/ground-control/blob/master/README.md#state-directory).

groundControl.overlayBrowsers.markdownDescription: Browsers that **Enable GitHub Overlay** registers the native host for on this machine.

groundControl.idleExitMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes the shared hub stays running after its last client disconnects; an activated editor counts as connected even with its board closed.

enumDescriptions: Adds CLI timings and session activity details.
Warnings and errors only; lifecycle lines are not recorded.
Errors only; failures still appear on the boards.
groundControl.logLevel.markdownDescription: Lowest level the hub records to hub.log and streams to log viewers.

groundControl.logs.rotateMegabytes.markdownDescription: Size at which hub.log is rotated.

groundControl.logs.keep.markdownDescription: Rotated hub.log files kept; 0 truncates instead of rotating.

groundControl.logs.dispatchRetentionDays.markdownDescription: Days to keep dispatched agents' output files in the state directory.
